notes.title: The 3D Stream Avatar Update
notes.content: [h1]The Stream Avatar 3D Update[/h1][p][/p][p]Hi everyone, we have an awesome update that adds some functionality into the app with some nice bug fixes and minor improvements. [/p][p][/p][h2]Object Cloner Object[/h2][p]In this update, we introduce the "Object Cloner" which as the name suggests---clones objects! This can be used to duplicate objects in the scene, from rubber balls to avatars. [/p][p][/p][h2]Stream Avatar 3D Tutorial[/h2][p]Below is a quick overview on how to create a 3D version of Stream Avatars. We use MixItUp here, but other types of software should also work as well. notes.title: Official Alpha Release!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to mtion worlds! Our Official Alpha Release[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]This is our biggest update since our pre-alpha launch! We are thrilled to officially launch [b]Multiplayer[/b], transforming mtion worlds into a real-time, collaborative creation platform. Build, remix, and play with others simultaneously in a shared worlds.[/p][p]This release also introduces a powerful new [b]World Publishing and Remixing[/b] system, a massive upgrade to the [b]Node Graph[/b] with grouping and procedural nodes, and sweeping [b]performance optimizations[/b] across the entire application for a faster, smoother experience.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ENrWDrMfCUc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]🚀 Welcome to Multiplayer![/b][/h2][p]Multiplayer is here! You can now invite others into your worlds to create and play together in real-time. This is the cornerstone our alpha launch and brings mtion worlds closer to creating the best social interactive game in existence.[/p][list][*][p][b]How it Works:[/b] Multiplayer is disabled by default in existing worlds. To enable it, simply enter your world and activate the [b]Multiplayer Spawn Point[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Real-Time Collaborative Editing:[/b] Build and modify worlds while friends play, live. All changes and additions of assets, node graph, and settings are synced instantly to all players in your world. It’s awesome for D&D sessions, playtesting, or just for fun![/p][/*][*][p][b]Edit vs. Play Mode (God Mode):[/b] As the world owner, you have "God Mode" powers to edit everything while others are in your world. Banish them, talk to them, or just create cool stuff for them, the power is in your hands.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Action & Spatial Trigger Sync:[/b] Node graph actions and triggers are fully synced across everyone connected, ensuring a consistent experience for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Avatar Upgrades: [/b] Multiple improvements to third-persona and first-person avatars. Pinning and movement work correctly with moving platforms. Spawn points are also configurable, allowing you to set custom jump heights and interaction distances in first-person mode (third person will come later).[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🌍 World Publishing & Remixing[/b][/h2][p]We've completely overhauled how you share your creations.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Publishing States:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Private:[/b] Only you have access.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlisted:[/b] Anyone with a private link can join.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Published:[/b] Discoverable by everyone on the dashboard.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Remix Your Worlds:[/b] Any enabled public world can now be"Remixed." This creates your own editable copy, much like forking on GitHub. A history of remixes will be tracked, allowing you to see how creations evolve.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgraded In-World Objects:[/b] Spawn Points, Launchers, and Spatial Triggers have a fresh new look to be more intuitive.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🧠 Node Graph Supercharged[/b][/h2][p]The Interactions Tab is more powerful than ever, giving you the tools for complex logic and better organization.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Organizational Nodes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Group Nodes:[/b] Select multiple nodes and group them into a single, collapsible unit to clean up your graph.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note Nodes:[/b] Add comments and text descriptions directly onto your canvas.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Logic & Procedural Nodes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Queue Node:[/b] Buffer and process actions in a controlled sequence.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enable/Disable Node:[/b] Completely hide or show any object in the scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Web: Open URL Node:[/b] Trigger a web browser to open a specific link for players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sine & Noise Nodes:[/b] Generate procedural values for creating organic animations, random behaviors, and dynamic effects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Object Reference & Interaction Nodes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]On Collision Node:[/b] Triggers an action when an object collides with another.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reference-Based Control:[/b] New nodes allow you to Move, Rotate, Scale, and set the visibility of any object from anywhere in the graph by passing an object reference.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improved Workflow:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Search: [/b]Context windows have search bars that allow you to find nodes faster.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New shortcuts: [/b]Use ‘N’ or ‘/’ to bring up a node context window to quickly create a new node. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Infinite Canvas & Minimap:[/b] Navigate your creations with ease on an endless grid, using the new minimap to jump around large graphs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgraded Move/Rotate:[/b] These nodes now operate on an object's local axes for more predictable control.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]✨ Dashboard & UI Enhancements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New Dashboard Layout:[/b] The dashboard now features a "Live" section for featured worlds, alongside the most recently updated public creations. Plans are in the works to update this and add better world discovery. [/p][/*][*][p][b]User Profiles:[/b] A new User Profile Page is accessible from the avatar menu, and profile links are now visible on all world cards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI/UX Polish:[/b] The chat box now blurs on focus loss, toast messages have been redesigned, and small visual bugs have been addressed for a cleaner notes.title: Mega Organization and Grouping Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]  
We’ve just released a major update packed with improvements to scene organization, multi-selection, and node management. Check out the highlights below!
[h1]Major Highlights[/h1]
[h2]Hierarchy & Group Creation[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/2cc54fc6485e0d1bc62e9d953b9507ea80792aa9.png[/img]
[list]  
[*]Introduced dedicated folder creation and management to simplify scene organization.
[*]Manage sets of items at once with new group creation.  
[*]Use a group's gizmos to easily move and transform entire sets of elements.    
[*]Data migration ensures everyone starts with basic folder structures.  
[*]Improved feedback when reordering or nesting elements, preventing invalid setups.  
[/list]
[h2]Multi-Selection & Control[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/0a87e9da5b4f7b04059d0fac5c9beda55c82309b.gif[/img]
[list]  
[*]Quickly select multiple items via box selection or grid selection in both the hierarchy and the node graph.  
[*]Refined highlight behavior for large, complex scenes, ensuring clarity on what’s selected.  
[*]Need to adjust locked objects? Hold [b]Ctrl[/b] and click to override the lock.  
[/list]
[h2]Node Enhancements[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/7b41f7ae7227e8bb56bf3e693a9003b83d796579.png[/img]
[list]  
[*]Grab and move around multiple nodes at the same time!
[*]Add note nodes in the interaction tab to annotate complex setups.  
[*]Connections are now selectable with a box selector, with a simple inspector for quick editing.  
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[h2]Avatar & Camera Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Resolved an issue causing avatars to appear in a T-pose under certain conditions.  
[*]Improved camera parenting logic to prevent accidental reparenting or misalignment.  
[/list]
[h2]Pop-Up & Inspector Improvements[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Pop-ups now properly close when clicking outside their bounds.  
[*]Fixed inspector refresh issues after selecting certain groups or cameras.  
[/list]
[h2]Clubhouse & Snapshot Loading[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Addressed bugs related to loading or reloading clubhouses, ensuring elements and states remain correct.  
[*]Snapshot restoration now behaves as expected, preventing misplaced objects or partial data loads.  
[/list]
[h2]Performance & Stability[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Removed unused code and logs to streamline performance.  
[*]Refined highlight logic for descendants and groups to ensure accurate visual feedback.  
[/list]
[h1]Important Notes[/h1]
[h2]Nesting & Parenting[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Stricter rules on nesting help avoid making an object its own parent or breaking the hierarchy.  
[*]If you had unusual setups, you may need to adjust them to fit these new rules.  
[/list]
[h2]Workflow Adjustments[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Group management and node transformations have changed under the hood.  
[*]Double-check custom scripts or integrations for compatibility with these updates.  
[/list]
[b]Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/b] This update is all about making it faster and easier to organize and manipulate your scene elements. If you run into any issues or have suggestions, please let us know on our community forums or Steam discussions. Enjoy the new features and happy creating!

[h1]Full Change Log[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a dedicated control layer for folder manipulation
[*]Supported child relationship on the UI to better organize scene elements
[*]Improved the DragManipulator behavior for smoother drag‐and‐drop interactions
[*]Implemented the first working dragging mechanic with a ghost element that accurately follows the mouse
[*]Fixed multiple bugs related to dragging elements around, including glitches during the drag start
[*]Resolved issues with elements changing position when their parent changes
[*]Enhanced visual feedback when dragging objects, including proper highlighting of the interval between rows
[*]Made the ghost element fully non‐pickable to prevent unintended interactions
[*]Allowed reordering of elements via drag‐and‐drop
[*]Added folder support by creating new folders, updating the folder inspector, and renaming “Empty Scene Elements” to “Folders”
[*]Improved positioning of the add and add folder buttons in the hierarchy
[*]Fixed bugs that caused elements to duplicate erroneously as children
[*]Enforced rules to prevent folders from being nested inside other elements
[*]Fixed a bug where dropping a row at an expanded element did not work correctly
[*]Performed a data migration to add starting folders automatically
[*]Prevented avatar cameras from being moved to an invalid parent
[*]Improved error messages when attempting to move an avatar camera
[*]Restored drag‐and‐drop functionality to the interactions layer
[*]Ensured that only the expand icon triggers row expansion, avoiding accidental expansions
[*]Prevented elements from being parented to their own descendants and fixed UI containment checks
[*]Fixed nesting issues in play mode
[*]Added methods to update the format and version for data migration purposes
[*]Checked and prevented cases where an element could be made a child of itself
[*]Made extensive updates to the selection system:
  [list]
  [*]Integrated support for multi‐selection via box selection and grid selection
  [*]Refined the highlight behavior for multiple and complex selections
  [*]Fixed duplicate and delayed selection calls
  [*]Enabled clearing of selection when clicking an empty space or after deletion
  [/list]
[*]Enhanced group management:
  [list]
  [*]Updated data structures to support group creation and management
  [*]Added a group icon and new UI controls for creating and destroying groups
  [*]Implemented group gizmos to allow easy movement and transformation of grouped elements
  [*]Restored the Create Group Command and ensured that group content is shown instantly upon creation
  [*]Fixed bugs with groups causing stack overflows and null references
  [*]Made group gizmos selectable and added shortcuts for group manipulation
  [/list]
[*]Updated node operations and enhancements:
  [list]
  [*]Ensured that move, rotate, and scale operations using nodes update child elements correctly
  [*]Created interfaces to separate common behaviors for detached nodes and elements with custom properties
  [*]Fixed issues with node‐based operations, including a divide‐by‐zero error in the mod node
  [*]Updated nodes to use the proper API events for transform operations
  [/list]
[*]Enhanced camera and avatar functionality:
  [list]
  [*]Fixed issues where avatars appeared in a T‐pose under certain conditions
  [*]Improved camera parenting logic to avoid accidental reparenting or misalignment
  [*]Corrected camera gizmo creation and ensured proper camera selection immediately after creation
  [*]Enabled proper duplication of avatars with attached cameras
  [*]Fixed bugs in display camera behavior and attachment button functionality
  [/list]
[*]Improved inspector and UI interactions:
  [list]
  [*]Fixed pop‐up behavior so that pop‐ups now close properly when clicking outside their bounds
  [*]Fixed inspector refresh issues, ensuring inspectors update after selecting groups or cameras
  [*]Cleaned the inspector upon element selection and prevented outdated settings from persisting
  [/list]
[*]Resolved clubhouse and snapshot issues:
  [list]
  [*]Fixed multiple bugs related to loading or reloading clubhouses, ensuring correct preservation of elements and states
  [*]Fixed the snapshot restoration process to prevent misplaced objects or incomplete data loads
  [*]Addressed bugs in the shutdown/quit sequence
  [/list]
[*]Streamlined performance and stability:
  [list]
  [*]Removed unused code and redundant logs
  [*]Refined the highlight logic for descendants and groups to guarantee accurate visual feedback
  [*]Fixed issues with quick drag operations being ignored by the control layer but not by the UI
  [/list]
[*]Added key modifier functionality:
  [list]
  [*]Enabled selection of locked objects via Ctrl+Click
  [*]Added a key modifier to allow selection of locked objects within the scene
  [/list]
[*]Implemented additional fixes for node graph interactions:
  [list]
  [*]Fixed logic node unselect issues on pointer down
  [*]Updated zoom levels for better visual scaling in the node graph
  [*]Fixed avatar movement issues when using the node graph
  [/list]
[*]Addressed miscellaneous bugs and improvements:
  [list]
  [*]Fixed JSON converter helper issues
  [*]Removed duplicate inputs on flow nodes
  [*]Handled clicks in the hierarchy while holding down Ctrl for better multi‐selection
  [*]Fixed typo errors in error messages
  [*]Simplified code for highlighting all descendants of a selected scene element
  [*]Fixed issues with quick drag operations and pop‐up overlays
  [*]Implemented feature updates as part of the major hierarchy update, reapplying many of the above changes in a consolidated update cycle
  [*]Fixed bugs with outline triggers, selection of elements of different types, and double calls to select nodes
  [*]Improved visibility and lock settings to ensure they are not overridden when loading a clubhouse
  [*]Enabled note nodes to be resizable, added minimum size constraints, and provided resizing icons
  [*]Added an inspector specifically for note nodes, and fixed bugs related to note node text updates
  [*]Simplified and improved the process for attaching cameras to displays and avatars
  [*]Fixed bugs related to the snapshot transform process and clubhouse loading
  [*]Updated project settings to support the latest changes in node and hierarchy management
  [/list]
[/list]

notes.content:
Hello creators! We are super excited to announce our 1st ever mtion buildathon! 🎉🎉

[h1]Theme[/h1]

[b]Game Room[/b]
What does a fun game room look like to you? Maybe it’s filled with arcade machines, maybe it’s a mancave for unlimited rounds of Dungeons & Dragons, or maybe it’s a puzzle designed to trap your friends… We challenge you to design the most creative and engaging game rooms in mtion. Let your imagination run wild and show us your creations! 

[h1]Timeline[/h1]

[b]Sep. 4 - 11:59PM EST, Sep. 25[/b]

[h1]How to Participate[/h1]

1. [b]Download mtion studio for free[/b] on Steam, if you don't already have it

2. Go to "Template" page from the creator dashboard, find the template named "[b]buildathon: game room starter template[/b]" in the "Community tab and add this to your library. Once added, use the option "Create New" to start building your own game room with it! (You will need to sync the template to your local PC first before the "Create New" option becomes available)

3. [b]Start creating[/b]

4. [b]Submit your game room in app![/b]

[h2]How to submit:[/h2]
1). Convert your game room clubhouse into a template
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/7328c6cb357bb932397b4779a64718d9f7756f88.png[/img]

[b]Make sure to submit your creation by 11:59PM EST on Sep. 25 at the latest for a consideration.[/b]

No mtion SDK allowed! The game room must be built entirely in mtion, using the starter template. Exporting custom assets using the SDK is fine.

Must haves: at least 1 interactive toys in your game room, 2 displays, all floors and wall papers should have textures

Nice to haves: posters of your favorite games and some story telling to your game room

[b]NO YOU CAN'T EXPORT AN ASSET THAT'S A ROOM[/b]

[list]
[*] Creativity (40%): Uniqueness and imaginative design
[*] Aesthetics (30%): Visual appeal and overall design
[*] Interactivity (30%): Interesting ways of using interactive objects, NPCs, Displays/Cameras/Lights/VFX, TTS etc. on the node graph to design engaging and fun experiences

[h1]Awards[/h1]
[list]
[*] Winning Game Rooms will be featured in mtion front and centre
[*] A chance to publish your game room as an interactive player experience
[*] Guaranteed for an exclusive title in a future mtion update

Have a favorite bot you want to use? [b]No problem![/b] 
Want more flexibility with your Elgato Stream Deck? [b]Easy-peasy![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/938af17b68a0cb3016b5d34ead26d377c6b69aeb.png[/img]

We exposed the timeline into the node graph giving you the ability to trigger timelines and receive feedback when a timeline finishes a cycle. 

[b]Play Timeline Node[/b]
Triggers the timeline to play, on complete the node will output an event. 

[b]Stop Timeline[/b]
Stops the timeline from playing. If in a loop, will stop the loop as well. 

[b]On Track Complete[/b]
Triggers an event every time the timeline completes one full loop.

notes.title: Patch #23 New Chat Triggers and Updates
notes.content:
Attention Creators! Get ready to dive into a game-changing update that's set to revolutionize your streaming experience with our latest and greatest chat trigger enhancements! 

[h2]Major Chat Trigger Overhaul![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/584479e5351cc6dc0eda0ae0bff54d4a7dbfff59.png[/img]

We've transformed the old triggers into the all-new Chat Triggers! Now equipped with a sleek Advanced Feature Toggle, this update is your key to unlocking a universe of possibilities for interactive chat engagement in your streams. 


[h3]Viewer Interactions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/fc3ad59140d0b58ca5f735d966b2be897839546b.png[/img]

Setting the target goal allows you to put a threshold on the number of commands needed before the trigger fires. If the target goal is 3, then three commands need to come in before the trigger fires. 

If Allow Multiple Interactions is disabled, then only one command per viewer will be counted, which means 3 different viewers would have to send the command. 

[h3]Goal Time Limit[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/528e75963a20ea30cf37bfd397ee6021fd13c79f.png[/img]

Setting a goal time limit will set a time limit before the trigger resets. This means that number of commands sent has to reach that target before it fires off. If the goal is not reached before the timer expires, then everything resets. 

The Wait For Timer to Finish will prevent the trigger from firing until timer runs out. By default, the trigger fires as soon as the goal is met. 

[h3]Limit Goal repetition[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/5c7582c3823025c9af1f174138cc9ecefbdf0eef.png[/img]

Setting this limit will disable the trigger once the goal is met, preventing anyone else from using it. This can be useful to limit special interactions to a single or small number of uses. 


[h3]Cooldown[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554994/a7b1edcda7665c2c311e8ee00d3ec5d0d0aeb101.png[/img]

The cool down can be used to help space out interactions or prevent spam interactions.

[*] Eliminated the pesky text display bug.
[*] Resolved the duplicate button issue for camera-to-display attachment.

[h2]Desktop Capture[/h2]
We reworked how desktop capture works behind the scenes making it more robust and performant. We changed the precedence ordering for how a frame is captured to default to a more efficient protocol. This means that the yellow border that you would typically see will no longer be visible when capture desktop is enabled and active. However, for devices that don't support this protocol, mtion studio will automatically revert back to the original implementation. This can happen on some laptop gaming PCs.

[*] Fixing tray minimization. Bug prevented the app from disappearing when enabled
